validation_source.text:
"""Real local Whisper inference on locally synthesized speech; no user recording."""
import audioop
from collections import Counter
import hashlib
import json
import math
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import time
import wave

mode = sys.argv[1]
assert mode in ('cpu', 'cuda')
folder = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
root = folder.parents[1]
run = folder / mode
run.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
os.chdir(run)
os.environ.update(HF_HUB_OFFLINE='1', TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE='1', HF_DATASETS_OFFLINE='1',
                  HF_HUB_DISABLE_TELEMETRY='1', DO_NOT_TRACK='1')
blocked = Counter()

def audit(event, args):
    if event in ('socket.connect', 'socket.sendto', 'socket.bind', 'socket.getaddrinfo'):
        blocked[event] += 1
        raise OSError('Network disabled for local model test')

sys.addaudithook(audit)
import requests

def no_http(*args, **kwargs):
    blocked['requests'] += 1
    raise requests.ConnectionError('HTTP disabled for local model test')

requests.sessions.Session.request = no_http
import numpy as np
import vrct_audio
from models.transcription.pcm_audio import PcmAudio
from models.transcription.transcription_providers import LocalWhisperProvider
from models.transcription.transcription_whisper import getWhisperModel

wave_path = folder / 'local-test.wav'
with wave.open(str(wave_path), 'rb') as source:
    original_rate, width, channels = source.getframerate(), source.getsampwidth(), source.getnchannels()
    assert width == 2 and channels == 1
    original = source.readframes(source.getnframes())
pcm48, _ = audioop.ratecv(original, 2, 1, original_rate, 48000, None)
stereo48 = audioop.tostereo(pcm48, 2, 1.0, 1.0)
mono48 = vrct_audio.normalize_pcm16(stereo48, 2, 2)
assert mono48 == pcm48
assert vrct_audio.downmix_pcm16(stereo48, 2) == pcm48
assert vrct_audio.rms_pcm16(mono48) > 0
clip = PcmAudio(mono48, 48000, 2)
canonical = clip.get_raw_data(convert_rate=16000, convert_width=2)
assert canonical is clip.get_raw_data(convert_rate=16000, convert_width=2)
expected = np.frombuffer(canonical, np.int16).flatten().astype(np.float32) / 32768.0
model_root = folder / 'model-copy'
weight_dir = model_root / 'weights/whisper/base'
weight_hashes = {p.name: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in weight_dir.iterdir() if p.is_file()}
load_start = time.perf_counter()
model = getWhisperModel(str(model_root), 'base', device=mode)
load_seconds = time.perf_counter() - load_start
assert model.model.device == mode

class ObservedModel:
    def __init__(self):
        self.inputs = []

    def transcribe(self, data, **kwargs):
        assert data.dtype == np.float32 and np.array_equal(data, expected)
        assert not any(np.shares_memory(data, previous) for previous in self.inputs)
        self.inputs.append(data)
        return model.transcribe(data, **kwargs)

observed = ObservedModel()
provider = LocalWhisperProvider(observed)
outputs = []
for _ in range(2):
    start = time.perf_counter()
    text, confidence, definitive = provider.transcribe(clip, 'English', 'United States', avg_logprob=-1.0,
        no_speech_prob=0.6, no_repeat_ngram_size=3, force_language=True)
    elapsed = time.perf_counter() - start
    assert text.strip() and math.isfinite(confidence) and 0 <= confidence <= 1 and definitive is True
    outputs.append({'text':text,'confidence':confidence,'definitive':definitive,'elapsed_seconds':elapsed})
assert outputs[0]['text'] == outputs[1]['text']
assert len(observed.inputs) == 2 and all(np.array_equal(data, expected) for data in observed.inputs)
assert {p.name:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in weight_dir.iterdir() if p.is_file()} == weight_hashes
native_hash = hashlib.sha256(Path(vrct_audio.vrct_audio.__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert native_hash == '8286bd9ca1f1221d1b14e7f4ccd7040d1d586a6b6fc469e5e15ffa148ca8fc53'
result = {'status':'PASS', 'scope':'source provider with real local base model, synthetic speech; no recording, remote ASR or downloads',
          'mode':mode,'actual_device':model.model.device,'actual_compute_type':model.model.compute_type,
          'load_seconds':load_seconds,'outputs':outputs,'native_sha256':native_hash,'weights_sha256':weight_hashes,
          'input':{'source':'Windows SAPI Microsoft Zira Desktop',
                   'text':'This is a local speech recognition test. The audio stays on this computer.',
                   'wav_sha256':hashlib.sha256(wave_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                   'sample_rate':original_rate,'channels':channels,'sample_width':width,
                   'native_test_format':'48000 Hz PCM16 stereo to mono', 'canonical_array_shape':list(expected.shape)},
          'independent_model_inputs':True,'input_unchanged':True,'raw_cache_reused':True,'blocked_calls':dict(blocked),
          'limitations':'Synthetic single phrase, two calls; no microphone-to-GUI measurement or recognition accuracy comparison. Timings under concurrent builds are not benchmarks.'}
(run/'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps(result))

independent_harness_review: LGTM; actual WhisperModel delegation and generator consumption verified
limitations: One synthetic English phrase, two calls per mode; not an accuracy benchmark.
Float equivalence uses the same canonical PCM; independent legacy resampling equivalence is covered in earlier tests, not this harness.
Timings include concurrent build contention and first-call setup; not a CPU/CUDA performance comparison.
Source environment inference; not packaged-model or GUI integration.
Python communication guards and offline/local-only code paths; no OS firewall isolation.

independent_result_review.scope: Read-only comparison of results, logs, source/script/wav/copied-model hashes and claims; no repeat inference
independent_result_review.note: Original-model immutability, SAPI generation and exit codes rely on parent execution evidence; confidence is language probability, not recognition accuracy.
